subject: Post-demo: SuiteQ structured-call flow + embedding mismatch causing 5xx
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya@suiteq.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up — structured call + 5xx seen from our side

Hi Logan / team,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the walkthrough on structured tool-calling and the reranker was really helpful. We started a quick POC this afternoon and hit a recurring 5xx when the stack attempts a structured-call of the internal reranker after embedding lookup.

Summary: when we send a request that includes the structured "tools" block (tool: reranker) along with dense embeddings (from your embeddings endpoint), we occasionally get a 500 from Redwood in the middle of the response stream. The sequence that seems to trigger it is: generate -> call tool (reranker) -> structured output parse. It happens roughly 1 in 8 requests with the same payload.

Ask: can your team help triage root cause? We can provide logs and a minimal payload. Also want to confirm recommended runtime settings for:
- timeout and retry settings on the client
- batching size / concurrency for embedding + reranker flows
- whether tool-calling + reranker is considered GA for production at our expected QPS (~12 rps)

Attaching a small sample payload and a short error excerpt.

Attachments: sample-structured-payload.json (10KB), partial-error-snippet.txt (2KB)

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Desai
Head of Integrations, SuiteQ
priya@suiteq.ai
+1 415-555-0191

---
On Sun, 16 Aug 2026 at 12:30, SuiteQ Demo Notes <demo@suiteq.ai> wrote:
> Follow-up items: verify embedding dimension and ID mapping between services.
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya@suiteq.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — structured call + 5xx seen from our side

Hi Priya — really appreciate the clear repro notes. Sorry you hit this during POC. We're on it.

Quick plan / asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm the exact endpoint + model variant you're calling for the generation and for embeddings? (model ids, versions)
2) Please attach full request ID(s) if you have them from your client logs — that lets us pull server-side traces.
3) We've seen two common sources for intermittent 5xxs: payload size / serialization hiccups when structured "tools" blocks are large, and race conditions when the reranker call happens synchronously inside the same request window.

Immediate next steps (what we'll do):
- Sean will attempt a reproduction in our staging environment with your sample payload (will try both single-request flow and split embedding->reranker).
- I'll provision a dedicated debug token that logs full request/response traces and extended timeouts so we can capture the failing stack.
- We'll propose a short checklist for your engineers (below) to try in parallel.

Checklist for SuiteQ engineers (try in parallel):
- Send the request with streaming disabled (non-streaming) to see if the failure correlates to streaming path.
- Reduce tool-calling payload to minimal reranker request (no unused metadata).
- Increase client timeout to 30s and disable client retries to prevent retry storms.
- If possible, split the flow: call embeddings -> call reranker as separate HTTP calls and compare success rates.

I'll follow up in the next 24 hours with the debug token and any initial repro notes.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0133

P.S. Marissa / Sean — adding you here for technical handoff and to track support ticket creation.
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@suiteq.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — structured call + 5xx seen from our side

Thanks — I pulled the sample payload Priya attached. Quick notes from an infra perspective after scanning it:

Observations:
- Payload includes a nested "tools" array with two tool entries (reranker + logging_proxy). The reranker block contains a 4k-character "context" field (this could push the serialized request over internal chunking boundary).
- Your embeddings call uses model "rw-embed-large-v2" per the sample; generation uses "rw-text-4.1". Those are OK, but we need to confirm the exact model tags (GA vs experimental) to pick kernel paths.

Repro plan (what I'll run today in staging):
1) Run the exact payload as a single request to our staging gateway with streaming off.
2) Run the flow split into: embeddings call -> separate reranker call with same embedding vector.
3) Toggle batching to 1 and then 8 to see if batching correlates with failure.

Temporary workaround suggestion for SuiteQ while we investigate: reduce reranker context length to <2k chars and target embedding batch size <= 4. Also set client timeout to 30s.

Log correlation keys I'll need from you (Priya):
- client-side request IDs (X-Request-ID if available)
- full Timestamp and the exact UTC epoch when you saw the 500s
- sample response body (we need server stack frames if present)

I'll post raw staging results and any server traces to the HubSpot deal thread and loop in infra if we hit a kernel-level failure.

-Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com
